title: Portugal Study Visa Pakistan — Requirements, Fees, IELTS & FAQ | SK Immigration
description: Portugal study visa from Pakistan (Schengen / EU): requirements, documents, fees, IELTS, low marks, timeline and FAQ. SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi.

faqs.question: What are Portugal study visa requirements from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Admission / enrolment proof from a Portuguese institution; Proof of means / funds; Passport and forms; Criminal record certificate (often legalized/apostilled). SK Immigration builds a full checklist for your case.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to study in Portugal from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Budget tuition + living + visa/insurance. Portugal is generally more affordable than UK/Canada for many programmes. SK packages from PKR 50,000 cover preparation only — not tuition.

faqs.question: Do I need IELTS for Portugal study visa?
faqs.answer: Depends on language of instruction. English programmes usually need IELTS or equivalent; Portuguese programmes need Portuguese proficiency.

faqs.question: Can I study in Portugal with low marks?
faqs.answer: Case by case — public universities can be selective; private options vary. We shortlist realistically.

faqs.question: How long does Portugal student visa take from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Often 3–6 months; police certificate timing matters.

faqs.question: What documents are needed for Portugal student visa?
faqs.answer: Passport, photos; Acceptance letter; Academics; Funds proof; Police clearance (apostille/legalization as required); Insurance and housing proof.

faqs.question: Can I work while studying in Portugal?
faqs.answer: Student residence may allow limited work — confirm current Portuguese rules for your permit type.

faqs.question: How to apply for Portugal study visa from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Secure admission, prepare funds/insurance/docs, then file the correct national/student visa. SK Immigration sequences the file; authorities decide.

faqs.question: What is SK Immigration’s fee for Portugal study?
faqs.answer: Student packages from PKR 50,000 for preparation. Embassy and university fees are separate. No visa guarantees.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee Portugal student visa approval?
faqs.answer: No. Embassies and immigration authorities decide. We prepare complete, honest files.

Portugal study visa from Pakistan — national student residence logic

Portugal is searched for comparatively approachable tuition in some programmes and an EU study base. Success still depends on a real admission, funds, insurance and a complete national visa file. Portuguese authorities decide; SK Immigration prepares.

What to prepare

  • Admission / enrolment evidence from a recognized institution
  • Proof of means and tuition plan
  • Accommodation evidence when requested
  • Insurance and criminal-record / civil documents as listed for your appointment centre
  • Language evidence if the programme requires Portuguese or English tests

Process outline

  1. Programme shortlist and applications
  2. Admission documents and fee planning
  3. Attestation / translations as required
  4. Visa appointment with a complete set
  5. Travel only after a positive decision

Rejection risks

  • Unclear study purpose or mismatched academics
  • Weak funds story
  • Missing civil documents that the checklist clearly asks for
  • “Any EU visa” agents with no university trail
